name: grant-through-system-link
what: A folder granted as a person writes it, /home/<name>/..., where /home is the system's link to /var/home (Fedora Atomic; issue 56). The command names it the same way and reads it; the link shows nothing beside it. Where /home is not a link the two names are one.

turns.text: I will read the report where you put it.
